request: Teach me to tie a square knot in under 30 seconds.
topic: How to tie a square knot
intent: Someone wants to tie a square knot right now.
goal: The viewer can tie a square knot and tell it from a granny knot.
promise: A square knot in two crossings.
arc: Two rope ends, the first crossing slowly, a pause, the second crossing, the finished knot beside a granny.

events.text: A square knot, in two crossings.
Right end over left, and tuck it under. Pull snug.
events.look: the right end going over the left and tucking under

holds.does: the first half knot tightens and holds

phases.why: each move of the rope one at a time

events.text: Now left over right, and tuck under. Pull both ends.
events.look: the left end going over the right

phases.why: the mirror move, a little quicker

events.text: Right over left, then left over right. If you crossed the same way twice, you've tied a granny knot, and it slips.
events.knows: Same way twice makes a granny knot that slips.
events.look: the finished square knot beside a granny knot

measure.derived: Derived once from the request, intent and audience; thresholds not named here take the defaults in bench/lib/settings.ts. Read sizes scale with how wide the frame looks: a classroom or meeting screen from the back looks narrower than a phone at arm's length, a laptop at a desk wider. A hold listed as still is one the plan asks to wait without motion.

context.why: someone tying the knot right now, phone in hand

quiz.a: Right end over left, tucked under.

quiz.q: What happens if you cross the same way twice?
quiz.a: You get a granny knot, which slips.

quiz.q: What did the screen show during the pause after the first crossing?
quiz.a: The first half knot pulled snug and holding.

quiz.q: What did the first half knot do during the pause?
How many knots were on screen at the end?
quiz.a: Two: a square knot and a granny knot.
